title: Time-partitioning Gaussian Process Mixture Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.20860v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose the Time-partitioning Gaussian Process Mixture Model (TPGPMM), a Bayesian nonparametric framework for identifying persistent regimes and modelling nonstationary dependence in time series. The model combines an adaptive Pitman--Yor prior on contiguous segmentations with regime-specific Gaussian processes, without imposing Markovian within-regime dependence. Learning the Pitman--Yor discount parameter allows adaptation to homogeneous and heterogeneous regime lengths.   A split--merge Metropolis-within-Gibbs sampler with exact Gibbs boundary updates jointly learns change points and model hyperparameters, quantifying uncertainty over segmentations and within-regime dynamics. With an RBF kernel and a fixed, conservative observation-noise level, TPGPMM favours sparse segmentations that distinguish persistent shifts from transient shocks. Simulations demonstrate recovery of the regime structure. Applications to the CBOE Volatility

translated_title: 时间划分高斯过程混合模型
translated_abstract: 我们提出了时间划分高斯过程混合模型（TPGPMM），这是一个用于识别时间序列中持续状态并建模非平稳依赖关系的贝叶斯非参数框架。该模型将连续分段上的自适应Pitman-Yor先验与特定状态的高斯过程相结合，而不施加状态内的马尔可夫依赖。通过学习Pitman-Yor折扣参数，模型能够适应同质和异质的状态长度。一种带有精确Gibbs边界更新的分裂-合并Metropolis-within-Gibbs采样器可联合学习变点和模型超参数，量化分段及状态内动态的不确定性。使用RBF核和固定的保守观测噪声水平，TPGPMM倾向于稀疏分段，能够区分持续变化与瞬态冲击。仿真实验证明了该模型对状态结构的恢复能力。该方法已应用于CBOE波动率…
tldr: 提出了一种贝叶斯非参数框架TPGPMM，通过自适应Pitman-Yor先验与特定状态高斯过程的结合，自动识别时间序列中的持续状态与变点，无需马尔可夫假设即可建模非平稳依赖，并能有效区分持续变化与瞬态冲击。
en_tdlr: A Bayesian nonparametric framework (TPGPMM) combining an adaptive Pitman-Yor prior with regime-specific Gaussian processes to automatically identify persistent regimes and change points in time series, modelling nonstationary dependence without Markovian assumptions and distinguishing persistent shifts from transient shocks.
